# Rentile

Rentile is a headless Kotlin Multiplatform dependency that prepares supported map styles and renders north-up XYZ basemap tiles to encoded PNG bytes.

## Documentation

- Home: https://rohittp.com/rentile/
- KMP reference: https://rohittp.com/rentile/kmp.html
- Source: https://github.com/rohittp0/rentile
- Architecture decisions: https://github.com/rohittp0/rentile/tree/main/docs/adr

## Public artifact

- Coordinate: com.rohittp.rentile:kmp
- Development version: 0.1.0-SNAPSHOT
- First Maven Central version: 0.1.0
- License: Apache-2.0

## Scope

Rentile targets a pinned, versioned basemap profile using local CPU rasterization and always returns PNG tiles. The current development snapshot implements constant backgrounds and a strict inline-raster vertical slice; vector, TileJSON, DEM, sprite, GeoJSON, patterns, hillshade, and independent icons are milestone work. It does not provide a UI map view, text rendering, a platform render loop, or caller policy for batching, priority, retry, fallback, or output caching.
